content.subject: Apparel fulfillment expansion and reconciliation
content.draft_text:
Hi Devin,
ShipMonk opened an apparel fulfillment center to reduce returns and SKU complexity. Teams that add a dedicated center often see reconciliation workloads rise sharply. We build bots that automatically match inbound shipments to inventory records, eliminating manual reconciliation. Could we schedule a brief call next week to explore if this fits your plans?
Zamp
